_about: Validation suite config. Every value here is environment-specific -- do not commit a filled-in copy with secrets or machine paths you do not want shared. Env vars of the same name in UPPER_SNAKE override the values below. Model provenance (path + sha256) is recorded per model under models/*.json; `bin/vmodel diff ffds` re-derives the facts and reports any drift.

cameo._host_workspace: RESOLVED 2026-09-26 from the running server, not from the sources: admin_get_model_status reported the open model's fileName as /home/mac/oc3/workspace/SAF-Cameo-Profile/SAF_Plugin/samples/SAF/SAF_FFDS.mdzip. This matches scripts/tool_contract_resources.groovy and contradicts scripts/admin_bridge.groovy, which says /home/mac/opencode/workspace. Override with CAMEO_HOST_WORKSPACE if your checkout lives elsewhere.
cameo._test_models: Test models keyed by task id. Values are paths AS THE HOST SEES THEM. The read-only tasks all use the SAF profile's FFDS sample: it exercises all three SAF domains and is 140x the size of the MCP-server showcase model this suite was originally pointed at. The mutating task uses a scratch COPY that must be created deliberately -- see tasks/T08-create-software-block.json.
cameo._profile_repo: Container-side path of the SAF-Cameo-Profile checkout, which supplies the sample models the task dataset is grounded in. The suite references a checkout rather than vendoring the models as a git submodule: they are 11.7 MB of binary that upstream revises on its own schedule, and a recorded sha256 (see models/*.json) is the reproducibility we actually need. Override with SAF_PROFILE_REPO.

models._about: Catalogue of local models under test, keyed by a short name passed to --model. Populate with the models you actually want on the scaling curve. 'provider' + 'base_url' + 'model' + 'context' + 'max_output' are written verbatim into the per-run opencode.json.
